findings.summary: The advertised read and rollback paths can silently migrate a consumer ledger to a schema v7 cannot read.
evidence: The v7.0.0 tag declares lesson-ledger schema 8; this slice changes the current schema to 9.
scripts/lesson_ledger_lib.py:446-470 migrates a v8 payload and writes it back during validate_lesson_ledger.
scripts/lesson_selection_preview_lib.py:29-31 invokes that mutating validator, while AGENTS.md:9-10 makes the preview the first planning read.
The release notes prescribe rollback by reinstalling v7.0.0, but after this implicit v8-to-v9 write the v7 validator cannot consume the ledger.
findings.action: Keep preview/check validation read-only and move durable migration behind an explicit authorized write path. Add an upgrade-and-rollback test starting from the v7 schema-8 ledger and document any required operator action.

findings.summary: Scaffold and persistence still resolve the same date-bearing subject key to different files, reopening the overwrite incident this slice claims to close.
evidence: scripts/retro_persistence_lib.py:275 resolves the persistence argument without carrying that subject-key role.

scripts/retro_persistence_lib.py:89-96 treats any name containing YYYY-MM-DD as an explicitly named artifact; this disables the derived-path collision guard at lines 277-282 before _write_text overwrites the target.

A pure evaluation for subject session-2026-08-29 produced scaffold path charness-artifacts/retro/2026-08-29-session-2026-08-29.md but persistence path charness-artifacts/retro/session-2026-08-29.md with derived=False.
findings.action: Carry an explicit subject-key versus artifact-path role through the persistence CLI, or persist the scaffold's exact resolved target. Add a date-token counterexample with an existing undated sibling and assert its bytes survive.

findings.summary: The staged prose advisory scans working-tree bytes rather than the bytes being committed.
evidence: skills/public/quality/scripts/regenerable_facts_lib.py:132-155 obtains only staged path names from git diff --cached.
skills/public/quality/scripts/regenerable_facts_lib.py:294-315 then reads each path directly from the working tree.
With a partially staged Markdown file, an unstaged edit can hide a staged finding or emit a finding and line number absent from the commit.
findings.action: Read each staged blob from the index and add a partial-staging test covering divergent index and worktree content.
